levels.name: Normal
levels.note: The guardrails themselves: policy-as-code admission, least-privilege identities.

levels.name: Freeze
levels.note: Change freeze: no new exceptions, and no changes by agent identities (enforced at admission), while the alert is triaged. D3FEND has no direct analog; it models countermeasures against the attacker, not a freeze on your own automation.

levels.name: Constrain
d3fend: Isolate: DNS Allowlisting (D3-DNSAL; partial: DNS-only egress, tunnelling over DNS still open at Q2)
levels.note: Evidence first (RS.AN-07), then contain (RS.MI-01): suspect DNS-only and out of Service rotation; approved images only.

levels.name: Isolate
levels.note: Deliberately isolate, not evict: Process Termination (D3-PT) would destroy the evidence. Override needs the IC's identity (PR.AA-05).

levels.name: Staged descent
levels.note: Exit criteria per level; every declaration and lift recorded (RS.AN-06).

dns.title: Q3's deny-all left DNS open
d3fend: Isolate: DNS Allowlisting (D3-DNSAL; partial: DNS-only egress, tunnelling over DNS still open at Q2)
dns.short: ATT&CK T1071.004 · D3FEND Network Isolation · CSF RS.MI-01
dns.lesson: Containment you haven't tested as a union of policies isn't containment.

evict.title: Evicting suspects under Q3 deadlocks
d3fend: Evict vs Isolate: Process Termination (D3-PT) destroys evidence
evict.short: D3FEND Isolate, not Evict · CSF RS.AN-07 before RS.MI-01
evict.lesson: D3FEND lists Evict as a tactic; under a containment freeze it destroys evidence and can deadlock against the PDB.

debug.title: kubectl debug went around Q2
debug.short: ATT&CK T1609 · D3FEND Executable Allowlisting · CSF PR.PS-01
debug.lesson: An image allowlist must cover every API path that can start code, pods/ephemeralcontainers included.

guard.title: The agent's ServiceAccount could scale the policy engine to zero
attack: T1685 Disable or Modify Tools (Defense Impairment, TA0112; was T1562.001 before v19)
guard.short: ATT&CK T1685 · OWASP ASI03 · CSF PR.AA-05
guard.lesson: Who can scale your policy engine to zero is a least-privilege question (PR.AA-05) before it is a policy question.

host.title: The agent's privilege policy missed host mounts
host.short: ATT&CK T1610 · T1611 · PSS Baseline · CSF PR.PS-01
host.lesson: hostPath and hostNetwork are in the Pod Security Standards Baseline; the tests passed because no fixture tried them. The July 2026 incident's missing control.

a.name: The quiet library
attack: T1195.001 Compromise Software Dependencies and Development Tools
a.short: ATT&CK T1195.001 · T1610 · T1611 · PSS Baseline

csf_text.PR.PS-01: Configuration management practices are established and applied
csf_text.RS.MA-02: Incident reports are triaged and validated
csf_text.RS.MA-04: Incidents are escalated or elevated as needed
csf_text.RS.MA-05: The criteria for initiating incident recovery are applied
csf_text.RS.AN-06: Actions performed during an investigation are recorded, and the records' integrity and provenance are preserved
csf_text.RS.AN-07: Incident data and metadata are collected, and their integrity and provenance are preserved
